notes: Hotfix Scope Bridge + Return Recovery. Fixes the runtime namespace mismatch that prevented Build064/Build065 isolated hotfixes from seeing the main app's lexical CARPETDB, CUTDB, LOGDB and DATA_KEYS constants. Restores the missing completed Cut Piece Return child-roll recovery path, including the RC2323 28'9" case, while preserving RC2323A and source-roll balance. Completed Stock returns are recovered idempotently and verified by sourceOperationId, child roll and returned length. Also allows the prior Carpet Cloud no-replace guard to attach to the real Carpet Inventory dataset. No schema change.
